moves.name:
Paldea
Analysis
moves.description: Increases the Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Applies Paldea Circle (Special) to the allied field of play. Paldea Circle (Special) grants all of the following effects: Powers up the special attack moves and special sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces special attack move and special sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 5%. The more sync pairs with the Paldea theme that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 40%, and the maximum damage reduction is 14%.)

passives.name: Paldea Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.
